'''Ta'Veel''' was a [[Defel/Legends|Defel]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Thaereian military]]&mdash;the [[Army/Legends|armed forces]] of the [[Thaereian system]]&mdash; during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. An [[Agent/Legends|operator]] in the military's [[Spy/Legends|secret service]] arm [[Thaereian Intelligence]], Ta'Veel was assigned to the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]], in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zham Hlar]]. He developed a dislike for the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Xirossk]], another Thaereian Intelligence agent stationed on Burnout, regarding him as soft and a poor example of a Trandoshan.<ref name="TAUT" />

Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']] is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> while monitoring the viewing area for an arena on Burnout in which prisoners were fed to dangerous creatures, Ta'Veel secretly observed a confrontation between Xirossk and a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]. Overhearing Xirossk entreat the assistance of the freelancers in deserting the Thaereian forces, the Defel notified his superiors on Burnout via a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]]. An alert was subsequently broadcast across the space station that denounced Xirossk as a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] and called for his capture.<ref name="TAUT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ta'Veel was mentioned in ''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]'', [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Morrie Mullins]] and [[Lee Pickler]] and set with [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity that was published by [[RPGA]] in [[2002]] as the second part of the [[Looking In trilogy]] of the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] roleplaying campaign.<ref name="TAUT" />
